Docs/Validation/Guide

Validation

Actual SDK callback lifetime regression

2 min readOdin × GodotPage source ↓

Source-only fixture, uncompiled/unrun until Root grants a case. The identical criterion runs against an explicitly supplied frozen pre-fix or current modules/authoring_demo/ directory. A pre-fix RED remains a failed report; the runner never promotes an expected failure to PASS.

Shell
python3 tests/box3d_production/callback_lifetime/run.py \
  --framework replay --module-source /absolute/selected/authoring_demo \
  --godot /absolute/Godot --odin /absolute/odin \
  --native-library /absolute/libogb3.so --native-sha256 "$NATIVE_SHA256" \
  --out /absolute/new-output --port 25130

Default is a no-job plan. --execute performs ordinary shared preparation, copies the selected authored package exactly, appends one derived-only Odin probe file, then uses the standard SDK build, ordinary import and one headless GDScript test. Kit uses the same command with --framework kit and its selected package. No shipping method/file or frozen module is edited. Generated source, including real method-return wrappers, is preserved and hash-bound. This is an SDK fixture, not exported deployment evidence.

The real authored Sample opens a Host on its unique port with processing disabled before it enters the SceneTree. Ready still runs; no Client, GO, frame, pump, step or reset is manufactured. Kit's pre-roster frontiers may honestly be null. Kit uses BOX3D_SAMPLE_SCRIPTED=0: its scripted close requires a completed target and terminal ACK, which this pre-GO lifetime fixture does not execute. Replay retains BOX3D_SAMPLE_SCRIPTED=1. Checked-close assertions are unchanged. Actual public status/presentation Strings and JSON are validated, then 128 warmup pairs precede two identical 10000-pair batches. Returns are discarded at each GDScript helper-function boundary. Three preallocated counter snapshots avoid retaining a fresh measurement container after each batch.

The one probe exposes primitive callback_temp_available, callback_temp_used, callback_temp_capacity, callback_temp_count methods in the same producer module/TLS. It first checks the actual context allocator procedure against runtime.default_temp_allocator_proc and nonnil data, then reads that actual Default_Temp_Allocator.arena. False availability / negative counter sentinel fails setup; it is never recast as an observed zero. No arena/context is replaced or reset by the probe. Exact total_used, total_capacity and temp_count restoration is required between all three snapshots. These are arena counters, not malloc totals, Native quota, Core gdext arena observations or RSS.

Godot OS.get_static_memory_usage() anchors must be nonzero, and the second identical batch may not increase that heap relative to the first. Heap and producer TLS are reported separately. Frontier equality/no GO/no frame advance, actual checked public close and freed Node are independent setup/cleanup gates. Source/module/tool/Native/binary fences and strict engine logs remain required. No timing, 4 ms, soak, network-recovery or physics correctness claim follows.
